name: get_customer_history
description: Look up a customer's account: plan, account status, recent account events, usage and past support tickets. Call this first for every ticket.

customer_id.description: Customer ID from the ticket, e.g. 'C-1001'.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

name: get_billing_transactions
description: Fetch recent payment transactions, subscription state and failed upgrade attempts for a customer. Use for any payment, charge, refund, invoice or plan-upgrade issue.

name: check_service_status
description: Check internal monitoring for active incidents, including ones not yet published on the public status page. Use for errors, outages, slowness or 'cannot access' reports.

region.description: Region to check. Use the customer's region; 'global' returns all regions.
region.title: Region

name: search_knowledge_base
description: Search help-center FAQs and internal support procedures. Returns the most relevant articles. Call once per distinct sub-issue in the ticket.

query.description: Search query in English using product keywords (translate non-English tickets first), e.g. 'dark mode system default not working mac'.
query.title: Query
